brief: Paired clipped-ellipse glazed shafts, different sloping crowns and elliptical mast over eight projecting diamond podium wings.

nativeAxes.origin: Signed engineer-plan tower center at the podium entry datum

reconstruction.tower: Published64×42 m plan reconstructed as two offset parallel clipped ellipses. The poorly traced map shaft does not override the engineer’s actual plan.
reconstruction.podium: Eight primary figure9 tips fitted without reflection to the full mapped podium. Primary-plan orientation is retained; overall tip registration RMS is2.09 m per coordinate.
reconstruction.heights: 232 m lower occupied shaft with240 m sloping crown;279 m upper plant floor and21 m blade upstand. Measured81 m elliptical mast reaches360 m.
reconstruction.facade: 4 m floor bands, individual glass panes, mechanical levels, end blade slots and triangulated projecting podium glazing.

limitations: Original 245998-triangle, 21729692-byte master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged global recipe. Reviewed source and four browser levels preserve two offset clipped ellipse shafts, different sloping crowns, silver end blades, complete 81 m elliptical two-section mast reaching 360 m, all eight mapped podium wings with closed roofs/soffits and raking supports. Replace individual framed glass cells with continuous opaque glazing, long facade strips and selected near wing trusses. Skyline/district omit fine frames and aggregate facade bands; native shaft/mast facet allowances 1.5 / 0.75 / 0.3 / 0.1 m exclude intentionally omitted decorative frames. Rooflights are repaired from flat discs to faceted glass domes; approximate 3.2 m base radius and 15.4 m apex are photographic reconstructions, not engineering dimensions. Published 64 by 42 m typical plan, 279 m plant datum, 18.6 / 20.85 m exchange datums and 81 m mast follow Atkins. Contractor secondary 240 m / 54-floor and 65-floor main description differs from current CVU 68 above-ground floors; external shaft massing follows the engineer. Signed map/drawing registration retains 2.092 m RMS and about 5% scale disagreement. Individual glazing pitch, minor louvres, secondary wing slopes, dome curvature and exact entrance thresholds are reconstructed. Three canonical shared 256 px graphs; no embedded images or copied photographic textures. Folded ground slab down to basement levels, terraced water feature below entry, parking, interiors, fine signage and night LEDs are excluded. No terrain-grade or physical phone/laptop performance claim.

geographic.notes: Fresh OSM API on 2026-10-10 confirms unchanged name-confirmed Almas podium 1137607706 and malformed shaft 1491743595. Retain the existing signed eight-tip engineer-plan fit without reflection, heading -0.669655293352136. Native +X points southeast, +Z southwest; largest diamond-exchange petal on -Z points northeast. Lower ellipse is north of the taller southern ellipse and its mast lies at the clipped +X end. Published 64 by 42 m shaft geometry overrides the inconsistent mapped shaft. Podium projection residual is under 0.002 m, while primary drawing/map registration has 2.092 m per-coordinate RMS and about 5% scale disagreement. Accept 3 m drawing registration / 1 degree reconstruction allowance; no surveyed doorway, grade or survey-quality control claim. Entry Y=0 and automatic footprint replacement disabled. Below-entry terraced landscape is excluded.
